The frozen R5 source constructs `severe_any` by thresholding both operator targets and applying `any(0)`, then writes that group/action label on each operator candidate row. R7 instead required each duplicated label to equal the current operator row's own target threshold, so the R7 input gate was narrower than the authoritative R5 label semantics.
